notes.title: Finally an Update! aka new look but same game
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25851120/a54cffa3e6442d796eafd42e3af7fc87ffd835c6.png[/img]

I personally apologize for the lack of updates from the development of the game in general. We hit some bumps in the road while re-designing the UI but this was a necessary step before we could proceed with any future plans.
That being said here is what was done and what we plan on doing

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Guild Limit Increased to 20 members[/b]
[*]GUI updated some UI buttons were moved so be sure you know where you're clicking.
[*]Monster images changed to vector images to scale better and run smoother
***The Ancient Mimic treasure box and Thors Volcano background still needs a makeover***
[*]Adventurer images changed to action sprites
[/list]

[b]Future Plans[/b]
[list]
[*]Addition of new monster cards and stat abilities
[*]More monsters to fight in Guild battles
[*]Guild monsters increased in difficulty
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and your continued support for the game.

notes.title: Some new additions and Squishing bugs
notes.content:
Some new additions and Squishing some bugs
[h1]Version 1.2[/h1]
[b]New Things![/b]
[olist]
[*]Game will tell you how much zeny you have made while away when logging in
[*]Leveling area Thors Volcano added to the map rotation
[list][*]Relevant monsters and music have been added[/list]
[*]Updated Raid background to Bifrost Bridge
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25851120/64d4556049e1702600aecbe525f583afcfe103e3.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25851120/355b4e7e1310219699ff34b07cf3f83c585a1293.jpg[/img][/url]
[/olist]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[olist]
[*]Fixed Card number limit issues
[*]Fixed Dark Lord card taking 2 Battle Manuals instead of 1
[*]Adjusted leveling cost for several cards to make them more affordable
[*]Fixed background music for the following leveling areas:
[list][*]Sunken ship
[*]Clock Tower
[*]Ice Dungeon[/list]
[/olist]

[b]Localization fixes[/b]
[olist][*]Fixed text to properly state Emperium
[*]Fixed name of King Poring instead of Equipment Ooze
[*]Fixed several typos referring to old Clicker Heroes terminology
[/olist]

notes.title: The one with the BGMs
notes.content:
[h1]A few Quality of Life fixes patched into the client[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added BGM for every 10 zones
[*]Fixed an error where Mammonite activations not showing in stat screen
[*]Fixed Mageanger the Mage sprite showing up as a Wizard
[*]various other asset updates and fixes
[/list]

[b]If the update doesn't self-download try restarting Steam[/b]

Thank you for all of your great suggestions. I will share more plans next week and some screenshots of what we have been working on for future updates.

Happy Clicking everyone!
